notes.title: Stitched HD Patch version 1.12

- Fixed map showing incorrect room number.
- Fixed inconsistent sprite art.
- Made it easier to spot certain key items in the prison area.
- Included missing dialogues for a puzzle in the West Wing.
- Fixed an issue where doll incorrect attacks player in the basement.
- Addressed a problem where an area was made accessible where it is not supposed to be.
- Fixed an issue with impassible tiles.
- Corrected several text clipping problems.
- Fixed a few movement issues for Catherine.
- Addressed a problem with music ending too abruptly.
- Modified final map to address screen tearing issue.
- Multiple dialogue clean up.
- Corrected grammatical errors.

If there are any issue, please let us know under our Bug Report thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/727340/discussions/0/1620599015880475725/

Thank you for playing Stitched HD.

Cheers!
- Fluffex Studios

notes.title: Stitched Re-release HD version
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

For this Halloween season, we are re-releasing Stitched with major updates! Below are the changes that we made to the game. Hope everyone enjoy the new update!

- Changed the game to support 16:9 aspect ratio with full HD support
- Added several new locations
- Updated existing story line
- Added 2 new endings
- Added a detailed map to each area of the factory
- Replaced various new environment tile sets with improved artworks
- Update existing artworks and added several new artworks
- Added full mouse support
- Updated save/load menu with improved GUI
- Updated in-game menu with improved GUI
- Updated option menu with improved GUI
- Added counter for thread obtained through in-game menu
- Added keyboard config support
- Full controller support
- Added animation for certain items
- Adjusted several maps to enhance the areas
- Updated various existing dialogues and added new dialogues
- Added new icons/update existing icons for hotkey and stability bar
- Updated a few existing puzzles to add more accessibility
- Added 2 new achievements
- Added 5 additional save slots
- Fixed various existing bugs

Below are several screenshots of the new changes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30942422/c71d71bf5d5c08ca3a48f3a6971a3bb59c6cd242.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30942422/66583f3638d00e82ff13565f6254ac7691b6e58f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30942422/24f454cf2a9eecc54cb7554af481e2cbabf8c03b.png

NOTE: Since this is an engine upgrade, old save files will not be usable. Apology for the inconvenience.

Also, stay tunes for future update on Mother's Nightmare.

Happy Halloween,
- Fluffex Studios
